problem.statement_latex: For a distribution $p$ on $[N]$, estimate $H(p)=-\sum_i p_i\log p_i$ within additive $\varepsilon$. The input is a coherent distribution oracle; its precise access model is part of the complexity statement.

quantum.headline_latex: $\widetilde O(\sqrt N/\varepsilon^{3/2})$ purified-access queries by Li--Wu and subsequent entropy algorithms; Shin--Jeong obtain $\widetilde O(\sqrt N/\varepsilon)$ in their quantum probability-oracle model.
